findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Potential SSRF or Insecure SSL in JWKS Client
 * @description Detects potential Server-Side Request Forgery or insecure SSL usage in JWKS client.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity high
 * @id py/jwt-ssrf-insecure-ssl
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-918
 *       external/cwe/cwe-295
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("urllib").getMember("request").getMember("urlopen").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("urllib.request").getMember("urlopen").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("requests").getMember("get").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("requests").getMember("post").getACall()
  )
select call, "Network request found. Check for SSRF or insecure SSL configuration."
findings.hypothesis: The JWKS client might perform network requests to arbitrary URLs (SSRF) or fail to verify SSL certificates.

message.text: Network request found. Check for SSRF or insecure SSL configuration.

 * @name Inspect urlopen arguments in jwks_client

 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/jwt-urlopen-inspection
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-918
 *       external/cwe/cwe-295
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("urllib").getMember("request").getMember("urlopen").getACall() and
  call.getLocation().getFile().getShortName() = "jwks_client.py"
select call, "urlopen call found. Arguments: " + call.getArg(0).toString()
findings.hypothesis: Investigate arguments to urlopen in jwks_client.py for potential SSRF or SSL issues.

message.text: urlopen call found. Arguments: ControlFlowNode for r
